lastCompletedStory.title: Rewrite cam-plan Step 2 to delegate to the gate (three-copy sync + embed)

nextStoryContext: US-006 is complete. cam-plan Step 2 now routes the no-arg none path through selectPlannableFromFile: reads issues.local.json via git show main:, filters stage==='specified' && status==='open' && !blocked, sorts by rank then numeric id. The integer-arg none path adds a D2 warning when stage==='idea'. The old P0..P3 priority sort prose is gone. Both .claude/commands/cam-plan.md and templates/commands/cam-plan.md were updated identically; src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via bun run embed-vendor. All gates green (1743 tests, typecheck ok, check:all ok). Next story: find the next passes:false entry in prd.json.
